notes: «فسألت ابن عباس فقال» : the one asked and answering is the last link; the saying is his answer
«خالفه معمر» names another transmitter with no chain of his own: kept as a one-link variant group, never a route
«مولى بني نوفل» is a nisba-like epithet written after the kunya; kept as written

fixes.reason: HKG places a second Yahya between Ali b. al-Mubarak and Umar b. Mu'tab; the text names Yahya b. Abi Kathir in that place

evidence.quote: قال حدثنا يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن عمر بن معتب
